{{Quote|I fought in the Foundry Uprising. My son taught me the nine edicts of Teräs Käsi. I'm not afraid to hurt you&hellip;|The soldier shortly before being killed by Teneb Kel|<ref name="Blood">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The '''Foundry Uprising''' was an event that took place in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Blood" /> by [[3678 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Foundry Uprising)|combatant]] who fought in the uprising later served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|guard]] for the [[Unidentified Advozse Governor|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]].<ref name="Blood" /> During the [[Invasion of Begeren]]<ref name="Blood" /> in 3678 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the combatant recalled their involvement while trying to threaten the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], who swiftly [[Death/Legends|dispatched]] the Human.<ref name="Blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Foundry Uprising was mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Alexander Freed]] and first published online in [[2010]].<ref name="Blood" />
